_note: The SEEDS, orders, conditions and numbering arms are fixed by the pre-registration and written here before the first call, so none of them can be chosen to suit a result. `models` records who was actually collected into this directory and grows as invocations land; see _roster_is_cumulative when it is present.
_provider_pins_derived: Read back from every record in this directory rather than typed: the collector did not record the pin when this arm was written, and the arm exists to contrast two backends for one model. Verified single-valued per model before writing.
